answer={
 'phase':'selection',

 'rationale':'The question requires Riley’s arguments. Approved part:1 and part:6 motivate scrutiny of state effects and conflicting capitalist interests without establishing Riley’s position.  'evidence_requirements':[
  'Contextual passages establishing whether stagnation is necessary, contingent or merely associated with political accumulation, including formulations permitting politically enabled productive growth.',
  'Passages linking accumulation, state action, interest formation and hegemony; distinguish Riley’s own arguments from joint claims and positions he critiques.',
  'Explicit international mechanisms and solidarity arguments, checking whether historical uneven development connects to contemporary political capitalism rather than assuming continuity.'
 ],
 'selected_sources':[{'source_key':key,'window_ids':[]} for key in keys],
 'selected_prior_reading_ids':['stacks:investigation:1','stacks:investigation:2'],
 'coverage':'Eight candidates marked readable, selected as whole frozen renditions: 372,948/400,000 characters; two prior readings. Their previews support this bounded selection, not completed interpretation. Whole renditions avoid arbitrary cuts but do not establish original-document completeness.',
 'gaps':[
  'Stagnation’s necessity and the connection between historical imperialism, contemporary accumulation and international solidarity remain untested.',
  'The growth premise remains conditional; the packet is not an exhaustive corpus, and unapproved Brief drafts remain contextual.'
 ]
}
schema=prompt['output_schema']
assert set(answer)==set(schema['required'])
for name, value in answer.items():
 spec=schema['properties'][name]
 expected=spec['type']
 assert {'string':isinstance(value,str),'array':isinstance(value,list),'boolean':type(value) is bool}[expected],name
 if 'enum' in spec: assert value in spec['enum'],name
 if 'minLength' in spec: assert len(value)>=spec['minLength'],name
 if 'maxItems' in spec: assert len(value)<=spec['maxItems'],name
 if isinstance(value,list) and name"'!='"'selected_sources':
  item=spec['items']
  for entry in value:
   assert isinstance(entry,str) and len(entry)>=item.get('minLength',0)
   assert len(entry)<=item.get('maxLength',float('inf'))
candidates={c['key']:c for c in i['candidates']}
assert len(keys)==len(set(keys))<=i['budget']['max_sources']
assert all(candidates[key]['readable'] for key in keys)
assert all(set(row)=={'source_key','window_ids'} and len(row['source_key'])<=180 and row['window_ids']==[] for row in answer['selected_sources'])
